Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and Results section is a ChIRP-MS interaction study. While the broader paper discusses ASO-mediated knockdown (genetic perturbation), the mass spectrometry data specifically compares proteins pulled down by SAMMSON-specific probes versus a LacZ control probe to identify interaction partners. Therefore, the primary biological variable for the MS dataset is the molecular state (protein-RNA complex assembly).
